[{"sha":"27614bf7475018dfd6685b69daf167f352ae44df","node_id":"C_kwDOAAdNeNoAKDI3NjE0YmY3NDc1MDE4ZGZkNjY4NWI2OWRhZjE2N2YzNTJhZTQ0ZGY","commit":{"author":{"name":"Domenic Denicola","email":"d@domenic.me","date":"2026-10-30T06:47:59Z"},"committer":{"name":"Domenic Denicola","email":"d@domenic.me","date":"2026-10-30T10:53:26Z"},"message":"Fix document.hasFocus() during focus changes

Determine document focus using the HTML has focus steps: start at the top-level document and follow the focused frame chain. This keeps document.hasFocus() true during blur events when focus moves within that document, including within iframes, and before any element has been focused in the top-level document.

Return false for documents without a navigable, following https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/13163. As in the existing focus model, assume live top-level windows have system focus.

Fixes #3794.
